English-02.question: 53) Select the sentence where 'after' is used as preposition-

English-02.question: 54) I knew him. Make it a passive voice.

English-02.question: ৫৯) Change the voice: 'It is impossible to do this'.
English-02.option3: গ) This is impossible to be done
English-02.exp:
• এই কাঠামো যুক্ত passive voice-এর ক্ষেত্রে সাধারণ নিয়ম ব্যবহার করা হয় না। 
- এগুলো একটু ব্যতিক্রম নিয়মে passive voice করতে হয়।

• এটা ভাবার্থের বিচারে Passive Voice করতে হবে।
- This is impossible to be done. সঠিক মনে হলেও সঠিক নয়।
- কারণ নিয়মানুযায়ী Adjective (Impossible) এর পর Passive Form এ কখনো infinitive to বসে না।
- তাই সঠিক উত্তর হবে - This can't be done.

English-02.question: ৬০) Which one is not a part of a formal letter?

There are six parts in a letter. These are -

2. Salutation or Greetings,
3. The body of the letter,
4. The subscription,
5. The signature of the writer and
6. The superscription of address.

English-02.option2: খ) We flew above the clouds.
English-02.option4: ঘ) Please reply to the above question.
English-02.exp: অপশন a তে above এর ব্যবহার হয়েছে noun হিসেবে, অপশন b তে above এর ব্যবহার হয়েছে preposition হিসেবে, অপশন c ও d তে above এর ব্যবহার হয়েছে adjective হিসেবে।

English-02.question: 68) They while away their evenings with movies and books. এই বাক্যে while কী হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে?
English-02.exp: They while away their evenings with movies and books. এই বাক্যে while verb হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

English-02.question: 69) Choose the correct sentence.
English-02.option1: ক) Always respect who is senior from you
English-02.option2: খ) Always respect who is senior of you
English-02.option3: গ) Always respect who is senior than you
English-02.option4: ঘ) Always respect who is senior to you
English-02.exp: Comparative Degree তে senior এর পর to বসে।

English-02.question: 70) ____ students were present in the class than we had expected.
English-02.exp: Student হচ্ছে countable noun. তাই এর পূর্বে fewer বসবে।

English-02.question: 71) Select the sentence where 'before' is used as conjunction-
English-02.option1: ক) I saw him once before.
English-02.option2: খ) He came before the appointed time.
English-02.option3: গ) We moved to Canada before the war.
English-02.option4: ঘ) Think carefully before you decide.
English-02.exp: অপশন a তে before এর ব্যবহার হয়েছে adverb হিসেবে, অপশন b ও c তে before এর ব্যবহার হয়েছে preposition হিসেবে, অপশন d তে এর ব্যবহার হয়েছে conjunction হিসেবে।

English-02.question: 72) Without working hard you cannot shine in life. (Make it Complex)
English-02.option1: ক) In spite of working hard, you cannot shine in life
English-02.option2: খ) Though he works hard, he cannot shine in life
English-02.option3: গ) Unless you work hard, you cannot shine in life
English-02.option4: ঘ) Unless you do not work hard, you cannot shine in life
English-02.exp: Simple sentence-এ without + gerund থাকলে Complex sentence-টি unless/if দিয়ে গঠন করতে হয়।

English-02.question: 73) Had I known you were waiting outside, I ____.
English-02.option1: ক) had invited you to come in
English-02.option2: খ) would invited you to come in
English-02.option3: গ) would be inviting you to come in
English-02.option4: ঘ) would have invited you to come in
English-02.exp: Third conditional এর গঠন Had + sub + v3…., sub + would have + v3 অনুসারে সঠিক অপশন হচ্ছে d.

English-02.question: 74) Select the sentence where 'but' is used as a noun-
English-02.option1: ক) It is but right to admit our faults.
English-02.option2: খ) No one but him deserves the award.
English-02.option4: ঘ) We tried hard but didn't succeed.
English-02.exp: But এর ব্যবহার: অপশন a: adverb, b: preposition, C: noun, D: conjunction।

English-02.question: 75) He is poor but honest. (Make it Complex)
English-02.option1: ক) Though he is poor, he is honest
English-02.option2: খ) He is poor and honest
English-02.option3: গ) As he is poor, he is honest
English-02.option4: ঘ) Since he is poor, he is honest
English-02.exp: Compound sentence এ but থাকলে Complex sentence এ though/although থাকে।

English-02.question: 76) In English grammar how many essential parts must every sentence have?
English-02.exp: একটি sentence এ দুটি অংশ থাকে। যথাঃ Subject ও Predicate/finite verb. The subject is what (or whom) the sentence is about, while the predicate tells something about the subject.

English-02.question: 77) Nature finds ways to ensure the survival of ____.
English-02.exp: The survival of the fittest (যোগ্যতমরাই টিকে থাকে) একটি বহুল প্রচলিত phrase।

English-02.question: 78) He is so weak that he cannot walk. (Make it Simple)
English-02.option1: ক) He is so weak that walk
English-02.option2: খ) He is weak to walk
English-02.option3: গ) He is too weak to walk
English-02.option4: ঘ) He is very weak to walk
English-02.exp: So----that থাকলে too----to দিয়ে Simple sentence তৈরি করতে হয়।

English-02.question: 79) These are ____ results I have ever had in an exam!
English-02.exp: প্রদত্ত বাক্যে সবচেয়ে খারাপ ফলাফলের কথা বলা হয়েছে, যা Superlative ধারণা বুঝায়। তাই the + superlative form + noun (the worst results) হবে।

English-02.question: 80) Her performance is ____ than it was a month ago.
English-02.exp: প্রদত্ত বাক্যটি Comparative Degree-র হওয়ায় worse হবে।

English-02.question: 81) The more electricity you use ____.
English-02.option1: ক) your bill will be higher
English-02.option3: গ) the higher your bill will be
English-02.exp: সঠিক বাক্যটি হবে - The more electricity you use, the higher your bill will be. (যত বেশি বিদ্যুৎ ব্যবহার করবে, তত বেশি বিল হবে)।

English-02.question: 82) It is the ____ city of the country.
English-02.exp: populous এর superlative form হচ্ছে most populous. তাই অপশন a সঠিক উত্তর। প্রদত্ত বাক্যটির অর্থ হলোঃ এটি দেশের সবচেয়ে জনাকীর্ণ শহর।

English-02.question: 83) Select the sentence where 'like' is used as noun -
English-02.option1: ক) We shall not see his like again.
English-02.option3: গ) Do not talk like that.
English-02.exp: অপশন a তে like এর ব্যবহার হয়েছে noun হিসেবে, অপশন b তে like এর ব্যবহার হয়েছে verb হিসেবে, অপশন c তে like এর ব্যবহার হয়েছে preposition হিসেবে।

English-02.question: 84) No animal is so big ____ the blue whale.
English-02.exp: বৈসাদৃশ্য বোঝাতে না বোধক বাক্যে so…..as ব্যবহৃত হয়ে থাকে। তবে so…...as না থাকলে as…...as উত্তর হবে।

English-02.question: 85) He said ''I shall go to office''. Indirect form is -
English-02.option1: ক) He said that he shall go to office
English-02.option2: খ) He said that he would go to office
English-02.option3: গ) He said that he will go to office
English-02.option4: ঘ) He said that he should go to office
English-02.exp:
পরিবর্তনসমূহ: 1. Reporting verb এর: said = said
2. Linker এর: that
3. Person এর: I = he
4. verb-এর: shall go = would go

English-02.question: 86) If you had invited me, _____.
English-02.exp: Third conditional: If + past perfect, Sub + would have + v3 অনুসারে সঠিক উত্তর হবে অপশন d.

English-02.question: 87) He said 'I am well'. Indirect form is -
English-02.option1: ক) He said that I was well
English-02.option2: খ) He said that he is well
English-02.option3: গ) He said that he was well
English-02.option4: ঘ) He said that I am well
English-02.exp:
পরিবর্তনসমূহ: 1. Reporting verb এর: said = said
2. Linker এর: that
3. Person এর: I = he
4. verb-এর: am = was

English-02.question: 88) I will kill you if you don't speak the truth. (Make it Compound)
English-02.option1: ক) Speak the truth or I will kill you
English-02.option2: খ) I will kill you, if you don't speak the truth
English-02.option3: গ) I will kill you, if you speak the truth
English-02.option4: ঘ) Speak the truth, then I will not kill you
English-02.exp: If যুক্ত অংশটি negative হলে, compound sentence টি তে 'or' conjunction যুক্ত হবে।

English-02.question: 89) This dictionary costs ____ the other one.
English-02.exp: as---as এর পূর্বে half, twice, three times ইত্যাদি ব্যবহৃত হতে পারে। যেমন- I took three times as long as I expected.

English-02.question: 90) Had I known her, I ____ her.
English-02.exp: Had + sub + v3 থাকলে sub + would/could/might + have + v3 হয়।

English-02.question: 91) He said that he ____ the previous day.
English-02.exp: Direct Narration-এ yesterday থাকলে Indirect Narration-এ the previous day হয়। প্রদত্ত বাক্যটি Direct Narration-এ Past Indefinite Tense-এ ছিলো, তাই Indirect Narration-এ Past Perfect Tense হবে।

English-02.question: 92) He said to me, ''How did you do it?''
English-02.option1: ক) He enquired of me how I had done it
English-02.option2: খ) He enquired of me how I did done it
English-02.option3: গ) He said to me if I had done it
English-02.option4: ঘ) He said to me if I have done it
English-02.exp: WH দ্বারা Interrogative sentence গঠিত হলে Linker হিসেবে WH word-ই ব্যবহৃত হয়, যা শুধু অপশন A তে রয়েছে।

English-02.question: 93) Though he is poor, he is honest. (Make it Compound).
English-02.option1: ক) He is poor and honest
English-02.option2: খ) He is poor but honest
English-02.option3: গ) As he is poor, he is honest
English-02.option4: ঘ) Since he is poor, he is honest
English-02.exp: Complex sentence এ though/although থাকলে compound sentence এ but থাকে।

English-02.question: 94) This could have worked if I ____ been more cautious.
English-02.exp: Subject + could have + v3 + if + subject + had + v3 + object অনুযায়ী সঠিক উত্তর হবে had.

English-02.question: 95) I know you. (Make it Complex)
English-02.option1: ক) I know what you are
English-02.option2: খ) I know who you are
English-02.option3: গ) I know what are you
English-02.option4: ঘ) I know who are you
English-02.exp: Subject + verb + object জাতীয় simple sentence-এর ক্ষেত্রে object নিয়ে একটি sub-ordinate clause ( who + subject + verb) তৈরি করতে হবে।

English-02.question: 96) Mr. Jalal has got three sisters. Jasmine is the ____ one.
English-02.exp: একই পরিবারভুক্ত ব্যাক্তি বর্গের ক্ষেত্রে elder/eldest ব্যবহার করা হয় এবং older/oldest ব্যবহার করা হয় অন্যান্য ক্ষেত্রে।

English-02.question: 97) A sentence is a -
English-02.option4: ঘ) group of words that makes a complete sense
English-02.exp: Sentence হচ্ছে a group of words যা একটি পরিপূর্ণ অর্থ প্রকাশ করে।

English-02.question: 98) Besides going to the book fair, I bought a number of books. (Make it Compound)
English-02.option1: ক) I not only went to the book fair but also bought a number of books
English-02.option2: খ) I went to the book fair and bought a number of books
English-02.option3: গ) Going to the book fair, I bought a number of books
English-02.option4: ঘ) When I went to the book fair, I bought a number of books
English-02.exp: Compound sentence-এ and, or, but থাকে। তাই অপশন b সঠিক।

English-02.question: 99) The 'predicate' is a group of words which -
English-02.exp: Subject সম্পর্কে যা কিছু বলা হয় তাকে predicate বলে।

English-02.question: 100) The boy who is begging from door to door is an orphan. (Make it Simple)
English-02.option1: ক) The boy is an orphan and begging from door to door
English-02.option2: খ) The orphan boy is begging from door to door
English-02.option3: গ) The boy begging from door to door is an orphan
English-02.option4: ঘ) The door to door begging boy is an orphan
English-02.exp: The boy is an orphan হচ্ছে main clause যা অপরিবর্তিত থাকবে। এখানে 'who is begging from door to door' clause টি who is বাদ দিয়ে একটি phrase-এ রূপান্তরিত করতে হবে, ফলে বাক্যটি simple হয়ে যাবে।
